g.text: Linux source tree: local and remote copies
94,775 regular files · 6,204 reported directories · 99 symlinks · 1.62 GB apparent tree size
Bars = mean command wall time over 3 runs; whiskers = observed min–max.
Source-host caches were dropped before each copy. Local XFS reflinking benefits rcp and cp; dcp copies file data.
Recipes: plain rcp, cp -a --reflink=auto, dcp -p, rsync -a. Preservation flags differ.
